name: Evocation
description:
About This Game

The core gameplay of Evocation differs from other card games. Your deck is distributed across the six nodes of the magic circle, and you take turns by drawing formations through connecting these nodes.

As a descendant of King Solomon, you are not only skilled in performing rituals but can also command demons. Performing rituals grants you energy, which allows you to summon powerful demons in battle.

After defeating a boss enemy, you can offer him/her as a sacrifice to a demon, allowing that demon to be summoned without consuming energy.

We have reimagined the relic system commonly found in similar games and evolved it into an equipment-unguent system. Unlike relics, equipment can be freely equipped, sold, and enhanced with unguents to grant additional effects. 

The single-player mode of Evocation includes 3 initial decks and corresponding card pools, over 300 cards, and 40 unique enemies.

However, we are not content with just a single-player mode. The core gameplay of Evocation is perfectly suited for a online PvP card game. In PvP mode, both players share the magic circle, with each player's deck distributed across the three nodes closest to them. You and your opponent can use each other's cards for rituals. This means that homogeneous matchups will not exist in Evocation.

The PvP mode will not include any in-app purchases.

Whether in single-player or online modes, we have invested significant effort into design and balance. We hope you can enjoy the game.
short_desc: Evocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.
